opening.argument: The observable process is an in-store beauty coupon redemption. The description says shoppers text BEAUTY to 827438, have a phone coupon scanned at checkout, and receive a $5 Target gift card. A frame shows a phone screen with a QR code alongside Target-related shopping content, consistent with that checkout procedure. The gift-card offer is therefore presented as an ordinary shopping promotion, not as an investment, credential request, payment demand, or deceptive off-platform scheme. The evidence describes the offer and how to redeem it; it does not establish that any shopper actually received the gift card.

citations.quote: text BEAUTY to 827438 at check out they will scan your phone coupon and you will get a $5 target gift card
